title: Personal budgeting app
summary: Track your spending automatically and stick to a budget.
whyTempting: Most people are stressed about money and say they want to budget.
whyItFails: Motivation decays. People use it for a few weeks then stop looking. Bank data access is fragile. Connections break and data is messy. Banks bundle it free. Banking apps add spending insights.
whatWouldChange: Open banking (e.g. Australia's Consumer Data Right) making data access reliable, plus agentic actions not just charts.

attempts.notes: Analysed users' bank data to suggest savings; closed July 2010.

attempts.outcome: Acquired by Intuit, then shut down
